tools.prompt: Create a 15-second cinematic naval-war scene about Captain Vale aboard Resolute, widescreen 16:9. Realistic naval-war-film photography, cold late-afternoon daylight, cool steel-blue shadows, warm amber screen light, controlled tension becoming decisive. Five coherent shots with natural cuts, the same crew and bridge throughout. 0–3 seconds: medium close-up, Captain Vale, a woman with cropped dark hair, a navy double-breasted coat, and brass binoculars, confirms the contact through her binoculars inside a narrow steel bridge with slanted front windows, a central chart table, and cool overhead lamps; slow push in. 3–6 seconds: over-shoulder medium shot, the lookout, a young man with curly black hair, a navy sailor shirt, and a red headset, points through the glass at a pale-gray cruiser with one raked funnel and a white stripe across its bow; lateral slide toward the window. 6–9 seconds: medium shot, the helmsman, a woman with a blond braid, a navy sailor shirt, and rolled sleeves, holds course at the wheel; beside her sits a small square tactical screen with a thick black bezel and amber graphics; slow push in. 9–12 seconds: tight medium shot, Vale lowers her binoculars, cool window light across her face; slight lateral slide. 12–15 seconds: wide establishing view, all three stand motionless at their stations amid steel bulkheads and amber reflections; ease back into a final hold. Sound: low engine vibration, subdued ventilation hum and faint sea wash, no music; at 10–12 seconds Captain Vale commands, "Fire main battery!" Hold the still bridge tableau for the final two seconds. Restrained saturation, cold cinematic grade, measured then decisive pacing. No subtitles, text overlays or added dialogue.
